Sources & methodology

Turnout: total ballots cast ÷ registered voters × 100, from Duval’s official 2024 election map data. All voting methods are included. County totals: 476,074 ballots / 649,929 registered voters. The precinct boundaries come from that election’s map, not a current precinct map.

Demographics: U.S. Census Bureau 2020–2024 ACS five-year estimates, tables B03002 (race/ethnicity) and B01001 (sex), distributed by Esri’s Race and Hispanic Origin and Population layers. Both layers identify their vintage as 2020–2024. Percentages use all residents, including children, as the denominator.

Categories: Hispanic / Latino includes any race; all other race categories shown exclude Hispanic / Latino residents, making the categories mutually exclusive. White, Black, Asian, American Indian / Alaska Native, Native Hawaiian / Pacific Islander and other race mean “alone.” ACS measures male/female sex, not gender identity.

Uncertainty: ACS values are sample estimates. Selected-area details show 90% margins of error (MOE) in percentage points. Race MOEs are supplied by Esri; sex percentage MOEs use the ACS subset-proportion formula, with the ratio formula when subtraction is negative. These estimates describe the 2020–2024 period, not election-day population. County demographic percentages are population-weighted sums of the included tracts.

Boundaries: demographic layers use Census tracts; turnout uses precincts. Values have not been transferred between geographies. Do not interpret area demographics as the demographics of people who voted. Census boundaries are cartographic, with some water removed; geometry is simplified for display.

File: data and map library are embedded for offline use. Optional OpenStreetMap background requires internet. Snapshot retrieved September 25, 2026. Gray means no data; zero is a valid value. Leaflet 1.9.4, BSD-2-Clause license.
